description: This file defines functions to create various Flex message bubbles (info cards, list cards, image cards, action cards, carousel, notification bubbles) for a UI component library, likely used in a chat or messaging context.

methods.name: createInfoCard
methods.description: Creates a FlexBubble info card with title, body, and optional footer.

methods.name: createListCard
methods.description: Creates a FlexBubble list card with title and multiple list items.

methods.name: createImageCard
methods.description: Creates a FlexBubble image card with image, title, and optional body text.

methods.name: createActionCard
methods.description: Creates a FlexBubble action card with title, body, and action buttons.

methods.name: createCarousel
methods.description: Creates a FlexCarousel from multiple FlexBubble items.

methods.name: createNotificationBubble
methods.description: Creates a notification FlexBubble for alerts or status updates.
